title: free_key_priv=NULL sentinel: document invariant in wp11_backend.h
description: fsdir and usb_flash backends set free_key_priv=NULL because key_priv points into the bulk-allocated keystore entries array, which is freed as a unit by wp11_keystore_free(). This NULL sentinel is relied upon by ks_slot_clear_keys() but is not documented in wp11_backend.h near the free_key_priv field definition. A contributor who adds a new backend and sets free_key_priv=NULL for wrong reasons (or non-NULL for right reasons) has no spec to check against.
